name: file
description:
Filesystem operations on workspace files. Use this instead of `execute_command` with `rm`/`mv` so the operation is captured in the file-changes panel and is reversible.

Subcommands:
- `rm`: Delete a file (or directory when `recursive=true`).
- `mv`: Move/rename a file or directory. Requires `destination`.

Both subcommands operate relative to the workspace root and refuse paths that escape it.

destination.description: Destination path for 'mv'. Required for 'mv'; ignored for 'rm'.

path.description: Source path relative to the workspace.

recursive.description: For 'rm' only: when true, recursively delete a directory. Default false.

subcommand.description: Operation to perform: 'rm' to delete, 'mv' to move/rename.
